question: Should this Cloudflare Sandbox container classifier wait for live Cloudflare Sandbox proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the reporter sample plus unit coverage?
rationale: The PR changes a platform classifier that drives upgrade-sensitive runtime behavior, and automation cannot independently prove the contributor's Cloudflare Sandbox environment.

options.title: Require live proof
options.body: Wait for redacted Cloudflare Sandbox terminal output or logs showing /proc/1/cgroup and the patched detector returning container=true before merge.

options.title: Accept sample risk
options.body: Land the narrow matcher based on the linked issue's cgroup sample and regression tests while explicitly owning Cloudflare variant risk.

options.title: Pause until access exists
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and pause this PR if nobody can provide real Cloudflare proof.

recommendation.title: Require live proof
recommendation.body: Wait for redacted Cloudflare Sandbox terminal output or logs showing /proc/1/cgroup and the patched detector returning container=true before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the closest Fly Machines detector precedent and has adjacent gateway/container-bind history for this compatibility-sensitive surface.
